user.title: Adaptive Lighting Helpers
user.description: Registers the adaptive_lighting_helpers.compute_lighting_groups and adaptive_lighting_helpers.compute_curve services - nothing below is required for those. Optionally, fill in these five input_datetime helpers to also get day-phase/curve sensors (morning_start, day_start, evening_start, night_start, day_phase, adaptive_lighting_curve, solar_adaptive_lighting_brightness, solar_adaptive_lighting_color_temperature) computed the same way, no separate YAML package needed. Leave them blank to set up just the services.
